title: AntiHaram
description: Unserious mod that adds a haram counter that increases if you do haram and decreases if you do halal, with a cool judgement day system & dimension
body:
# AntiHaram
###### this mod is not made to disrespect Islamic religion
## A very very cursed mod, that prohibits haram
Warning! This mod requires to be on the server, but is optional on client but highly recommended!

Have you ever wanted to play halal? This mod makes it easy!

## Features:
- Haram counter
- Judgement day (with a dimension)
- Multiplayer support
- Charity
- Everything is in config

## Config:
/antiharam:
- announce = do we announce haram
- charity = donate to charity
- enable = is the mod enabled
- event
- - animal = do you get haram for torturing animal (defined in faq) (default=true)
- - charity = do we enable charity (default=true)
- - difficulty = does doing haram make the game harder (default=true)
- - food = does eating haram give u haram (default=true)
- - judgement_dimension = do we use the custom dimension instead of the boring ui (default=false)
- - prayer = does the game give u haram for playing during prayer hours (default=true)
- - ramadan = can players only eat at night (default=false)
- - tab = show player haram counter in tab (default=true)
- haramlist = show what triggers haram
- interval = interval between judgement day (default 10)
- judge = manually force judgement day (debug)
- judgement = enable judgement day? (default=true) (blev forced me to)
- list = show what players did what
- ramadan (kinda buggy)
- - start = starts ramadan
- - status = is it on or no
- - end = ends ramadan
- reset = reset all stats
- status = shows config
- threshold = amount of haram before you get executed (default=3)

## Faq:
### How does this mod work?
All players have a haram count, and if you do haram, your counter gets added 1, if you have more than the threshold during judgment day, you will be executed

### What does donating to charity do?
It decreases your haram counter:

and it doesn't get reset on judgment day

### What permission can edit configs?
Operator, if you are in multiplayer, if in singleplayer you can use it regardless of having commands

### What if I dont have the mod on the client:
- No judgement day GUI, it will happen in chat
- No haram counter GUI, only tab
- Yeah thats it
